title: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Large Screen Monitoring (LED Video Wall) at National Data Centre, Deep Bhavan, Mumbai
summary: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a large screen monitoring LED video wall, with 5 years warranty, at the National Data Centre in Deep Bhavan, Mumbai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai

sites.name: National Data Centre, Deep Bhavan, Mumbai
sites.work: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of Large Screen Monitoring (LED Video Wall)

scope.item: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Large Screen Monitoring (LED Video Wall), with 05 years warranty
scope.site: National Data Centre, Deep Bhavan, Mumbai

money.notes: EMD by Demand Draft/FDR of any Nationalized Bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai, payable at Mumbai; EMD validity 90 days from publishing. MSEs registered with MSME/NSIC for similar works exempt from EMD with Bid Security Declaration Form (Annexure-I); medium enterprises with turnover above Rs 50 crore not exempt.

period.completion: 90 days from the date of award of contract

eligibility: At least 5 years' experience in SITC of similar work

Similar works completed for Government of India/State Governments/PSUs/reputed firms during last seven years ending 31.12.2024: one work >= 80% of estimate (Rs 1.8 crore), or two works each >= 50% (Rs 1.125 crore), or three works each >= 40% (Rs 0.9 crore)

Similar work means design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of display systems (Plasma/LCD/LED/Projector) or any other monitoring system for network operations, simulators, fleet view monitoring etc.
Agency must not be blacklisted by Central Govt., State Govt. or any departments or PSUs
Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers eligible under Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
specs: LED video wall (Large Screen Monitoring) for National Data Centre
notes: Notice only (Section I); no technical specification or BOQ included. Pre-bid meeting remotely by e-mail or physically at Deep Bhavan. Bid submission 07.02.2025 15:00 to 03.03.2025 16:00; technical bid opening 04.03.2025 16:30. Listing gives no bid opening date. Note numbering starts at 2.
